answer: Agents register by contributing a unique compute trace to a shared kernel that measures microsecond timing variance across distributed nodes — the velvet noise floor of network jitter becomes the entropy source. An attacker faking N identities must simulate N distinct physical network paths with uncorrelated jitter, costing O(N) real ISP contracts and geographic diversity. At each dawn epoch the kernel re-samples the fingerprint; sybils drift out of correlation within two rounds.
